snippet.description:
The 2026 World Series is officially underway and we had an awesome time at Game 1 between the Brewers and Rays! This game was nuts and we reacted to all of the biggest plays, in addition to talking to players and other media members before the game. Plus, we have another giveaway for you at the end 👀

First we had to toss it back to media day, where we talked with Brewers starting pitcher Brandon Woodruff and outfielder Sal Frelick about what this season has meant for Milwaukee fans. This fanbase has been starving to get to this point, and now that they’re finally here this squad wants to get the job done for them. Brandon even said that watching the fans' reactions can almost bring a tear to his eye! 

During the pregame we officially made it a World Series trip by reuniting with Jeremy Guthrie, who gave us his take on who would win this year's World Series. We also ran into 2 of our favorite creators from Jomboy Media, Joez McFly and Jolly Olive, and got their takes on who’s taking home the trophy. Of course, we had to give our predictions too before making our way up to the press overflow section…which was quite different from year’s past in a sick way 🔥

The game itself did not disappoint, as we were treated to an incredible pitching performance on both sides. We spent some time exploring American Family Field which has some incredible views from so many different angles, and even caught fans watching from OUTSIDE just to get a peak of their team in the World Series. That was some serious dedication 🦾Ultimately the fans were treated to a win, with the Brewers taking down the Rays 3-2.

We'll pick one of you from the comments to win a jersey of your choice 💯 Be sure to stay tuned for our next full YouTube video when we head down to Tropicana Field in Tampa Bay for Game 3 of the series. Also be on the look out on our Instagram and Tik Tok @batboysbaseball for tons of other content we’ll have coming from this year’s Fall Classic!

snippet.title: 24 Hours W/ the Brewers and Rays! (World Series)
snippet.description:
Coming to you live from Milwaukee for the 2026 World Series media day! We had an absolutely insane time and talked to so many different players from each team that you do not want to miss. This is our 1st time making media day it’s own video and we hope you all enjoy all the dope interviews we got 🔥

First up we talked to the National League Champion Milwaukee Brewers, after they completed a 4 game sweep of the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS. This squad is playing incredible baseball right now and the fanbase is starving for a championship. We can’t wait to see the energy they bring to this series 👀 American Family Field is gonna be absolutely rocking for every single game. 

After the Brewers team press conference, we went down to the field to catch a little bit of their workout. When we returned upstairs, MLB had laid out samples of some of the best food the Brewers are serving this World Series, and it was absolutely delicious. We’re definitely gonna have to go look for some of these during the first 2 games, and see how it compares to what Tampa Bay has to offer 😋

After we filled up we talked to the American League Champion Tampa Bay Rays, who took down the Cleveland Guardians in 6 games, 4-2. They’re playing such a cool style of baseball that involves bunting, small ball, and exceptional defense that’s led them to the final round. Neither team has ever won a World Series before, and it’s so sick that we’re going to see a 1st time World Series Champion 💯

We finished the day by heading down to the field to watch the Rays team workout before calling it a day. Don’t forget to enter our giveaway from this video by commenting your team, jersey size, and which player you want with your Instagram! We'll pick one of you from the comments to win a jersey of your choice. Stay tuned for the video we’ll have coming from Game 1, even more from Tampa Bay when we get down there, and everything we’ll put out on our Instagram and Tik Tok @batboysbaseball from the rest of the series! 🦾

snippet.description:
In this interview we interviewed 2 of MLB's newest Japanese stars, Kazuma Okamoto and Tomoyuki Sugano. We also interviewed Yusuke Oshima, Kazuma's interpreter, about how he got his job! Shoutout to these guys for taking the time to talk with us this season! We can't wait to see what 2027 holds for them. 

Before he was hitting home runs in Toronto, Kazuma Okamoto was a kid from Gojō, Nara, playing catch with his older brother in a family where neither parent had played baseball. He became a high school legend at Chiben Gakuen, hitting 73 career home runs and becoming only the 19th player ever to homer twice in one game at Spring Koshien. He grew up a Hanshin Tigers fan, but their rivals, the Yomiuri Giants, took him in the first round of the 2014 NPB Draft. Over 11 seasons in Tokyo, he became one of Japan’s most feared hitters, and manager Tatsunori Hara gave him the nickname “The Young General.”

Okamoto made six All-Star teams, won three Central League home run titles, two RBI crowns, and three Golden Gloves, and hit at least 25 homers every year from 2018 to 2024. On the world stage, he homered in the 2023 World Baseball Classic final against Team USA to help Japan win gold. An elbow injury limited him to 69 games in 2025, and after that season the Giants posted him to MLB. The Blue Jays signed him to a four-year, $60 million deal in January 2026, and Toronto won out partly because he let his daughter pick her favorite MLB logo and she chose the Jays.

His rookie season delivered: he hit more than 30 home runs, was named AL Rookie of the Month for June, and had his first four-hit game in September. Away from the field, he’s a huge Southern All Stars fan who has walked up to “Kibo No Wadachi” since his Giants days! 

トロントで本塁打を放つようになる以前、岡本和真は奈良県五條市で育った少年だった。野球経験のない両親のもとに生まれ、兄とキャッチボールをして遊ぶ日々を送っていた。智弁学園高校では伝説的な選手として名を馳せ、高校通算73本塁打を記録。春の甲子園大会では、史上19人目となる1試合2本塁打を達成した。幼い頃から阪神タイガースのファンだったが、2014年のNPBドラフト会議で、そのライバルである読売ジャイアンツから1位指名を受けた。東京での11シーズンを通じて、日本球界を代表する「最も恐れられる打者」の一人へと成長し、当時の原辰徳監督からは「若大将」という愛称で呼ばれた。

岡本はオールスターゲームに6度選出され、セ・リーグで本塁打王を3回、打点王を2回獲得したほか、ゴールデングラブ賞も3度受賞している。2018年から2024年にかけては、7年連続で25本塁打以上を記録した。国際舞台では、2023年のワールド・ベースボール・クラシック（WBC）決勝のアメリカ戦で本塁打を放ち、日本代表の優勝に貢献した。2025年は肘の怪我により69試合の出場にとどまったが、シーズン終了後、ジャイアンツはポスティングシステムを利用して彼のメジャーリーグ（MLB）挑戦を容認した。2026年1月、トロント・ブルージェイズと4年総額6000万ドルの契約を締結。ブルージェイズへの入団が決まった背景には、娘がMLB各球団のロゴの中からブルージェイズのものを選んだというエピソードもある。

メジャー1年目から期待に応える活躍を見せ、30本塁打以上を記録したほか、6月にはアメリカン・リーグの月間最優秀新人（ルーキー・オブ・ザ・マンス）に選出された。9月には自身初となる1試合4安打も達成している。グラウンド外では、国民的バンド「サザンオールスターズ」の大ファンとして知られており、ジャイアンツ時代から打席に向かう際の登場曲には、彼らの楽曲『希望の轍』を使用している。

Tomoyuki Sugano’s road to pro baseball started with a decision most players would never make. At Tokai University he went 37–4 with a 0.57 ERA, and he wanted to play for the Yomiuri Giants under his uncle, manager Tatsunori Hara. When the Nippon-Ham Fighters won his rights in the 2011 draft lottery instead, he turned them down and sat out a full year without pitching in an official game. The gamble paid off when the Giants made him their first pick in 2012.

Over 12 seasons in Tokyo, Sugano became one of the best pitchers in Japanese baseball, going 136–74 with a 2.43 ERA and winning three Central League MVPs and two Sawamura Awards. In 2018 he won the pitching Triple Crown and threw a postseason no-hitter against the Yakult Swallows. The Giants posted him after 2020, but the pandemic froze the MLB market and he returned to Japan, a letdown he has said sometimes brought him to tears. He answered with a 15–3, 1.67 ERA season in 2024 that earned him a third MVP and finally his ticket to the majors.

At 35, Sugano signed with the Baltimore Orioles and made 30 starts as an MLB rookie, finishing 10–10. In 2026 he joined the Colorado Rockies, bringing the deep pitch mix that earned him the nickname “Tommy Sugar” and his trademark command to Coors Field.

東京での12シーズンを通じて、菅野は日本球界屈指の投手へと成長した。通算成績は136勝74敗、防御率2.43を記録し、セ・リーグMVPを3度、沢村賞を2度受賞した。2018年には投手三冠を達成し、ポストシーズンでは東京ヤクルトスワローズ相手にノーヒットノーランを成し遂げた。2020年オフにはポスティングシステムを利用してメジャーリーグ（MLB）への挑戦を試みたが、パンデミックの影響でMLBの市場が停滞し、日本への残留を余儀なくされた。この時の悔しさは、時に涙を流すほどだったと本人は語っている。しかし、2024年シーズンには15勝3敗、防御率1.67という成績を残して3度目のMVPに輝き、ついにメジャーリーグへの切符を掴み取った。

35歳となった菅野はボルチモア・オリオールズと契約。MLBルーキーイヤーは30試合に先発登板し、10勝10敗という成績を残した。2026年にはコロラド・ロッキーズへ移籍し、「トミー・シュガー」の愛称の由来となった多彩な球種と、代名詞とも言える制球力を武器に、クアーズ・フィールドのマウンドに立った。

snippet.title: Full day of MLB Training with Cleveland Guardians’ slugger Jo Adell🔥⚾️ #shorts
snippet.description:
Save/Share this video and try this workout next time you go to the gym🔥🦾 Even if you just incorporate a few of these exercises in your next workout you won’t regret it because I felt so awesome and explosive😎 It was so sick seeing the MLB Training that Guardians’ slugger Jo Adell does behind the scenes to hit bombs😈 Idk if this will help you hit triples in the playoffs and come through in the clutch but this workout was no joke🥵 Jo is the homie and it’s been electric watching him ball out in the postseason with the Cleveland Guardians😎 Make sure to watch the full video on YouTube!!⚾️
FULL WORKOUT BELOW: 

Interval sprints:
30 seconds on, 15 off 
10 sets, 5 incline, 10 mph 

77 second plank 

Manual quad: 12 each leg 

Med ball throws:
3 heavy, 3 light each side 

Superset 1: Barbell Reverse Lunge 
Up to 275 lbs. 
4 sets, 3-5 each leg 

Superset 1: Dumbbell RDLs
70 lb. dumbbells 
3 sets, 6 each leg 

Superset 1: Lateral box jumps 
2 sets, 3 each leg 

Single leg box squats:
40 lbs. 
2 sets, 5 each leg

Manual hamstring:
6 each leg 

Ab roll out:
2 sets, 10 reps 

Side holds: 30 seconds each side 

Banded step-up: 5 each leg 

Med ball deceleration:
14 lbs. 
10 each side 

🚨DISCLAIMER: There’s also a TON stretching and mobility stuff not in these clips so make sure to check out the full vid on YouTube!! Shoutout to Angels’ strength coach Dylan Cintula for taking us through this workout🔥 Who should I train with next?👀 #workout #athlete #hitting #postseason #baseballtraining
